images.test_scope: Exact image flashed and verified on a 1541. User confirmed standard DOS boot and game load, IEC address and ROM settings save, write-protect and reset operate, and Control/Monitor firmware work on the drive. Full USB disconnect/reconnect persistence was not reported. Earlier 47 loose-board checks are recorded separately.

User-confirmed LED control during reads and full power-cycle persistence; .31 capture log and native regressions retained. Public image uses default NV and two equal-length diagnostic filename replacements (212 bytes).
